purpose: Broaden Ferrum's defensive cyber-physical priors and register public HIL evidence without revising the published v1 catalog or treating narrative reports as measured trajectories.
inclusion_criteria: The source is a government or regulator publication, a first-party company disclosure, a peer-reviewed paper, or an official public dataset record.
The source documents an observed cyber event, controlled cyber-physical experiment, public HIL trace, or a directly relevant defensive taxonomy.
The event has an observed or explicitly bounded operational, control, safety, recovery, or physical-process effect.
A defensive abstraction can be represented without retaining exploit steps, credentials, payloads, ports, or intrusion procedures.
Only one source from an incident family may generate scenarios; additional reports of the same event family are corroboration-only.
exclusion_criteria: Unverified social-media claims, unattributed summaries, vulnerability-only advisories with no observed event, hypothetical scenarios, and marketing claims are excluded from incident generation.
Reports that describe only data confidentiality impact with no operational, control, safety, recovery, or physical-process effect are excluded.
Restricted datasets are catalogued but are not downloaded, redistributed, fitted, or evaluated without their required agreement.
Narrative sources never supply transition targets or danger labels.

search_scope.sampling_rule: Retain every distinct direct-control or physical-safety event found, plus representative first-party operational-disruption events for each sector/effect/evidence cell. Additional events that repeat an already-covered cell remain corroboration-only so common manufacturing disclosures cannot overwhelm rarer OT cases.
search_scope.stopping_rule: Stop the documented search after two complete sector-by-source-class passes add fewer than two new eligible sector/effect/evidence cells; preserve additional corroborating candidates and reasons. This bounds 'as many as possible' to a reproducible stratified public-source search rather than an unprovable claim of exhaustiveness.

claim_boundary: The base v1 catalog and its published v3 results remain immutable.
Narrative incident reports supply defensive state-distribution priors only; Ferrum's deterministic simulator supplies their transitions and danger labels.
HAI 23.05 is separately evaluated as recorded HIL/testbed telemetry and is never described as a real criminal incident or Ferrum-controlled hardware.
Unmeasured HAI-to-Ferrum state dimensions are marked unavailable and receive fixed neutral values; they are excluded from real-trace error claims.
No model result constitutes physical-device certification, independent safety assessment, or permission to actuate hardware.

additional_sources.title: Manhattan U.S. Attorney Announces Charges Against Seven Iranians for Conducting Coordinated Campaign of Cyber Attacks
additional_sources.defensive_abstraction: Represent unauthorized remote control access whose physical path is unavailable or manually disconnected as denied actuation plus manual fallback.
additional_sources.limitations: The conduct was alleged in an indictment; the sluice gate was manually disconnected and therefore was not actuated.

additional_sources.title: Tracy Resident Charged With Computer Attack On Discovery Bay Water Treatment Facility
additional_sources.defensive_abstraction: Represent removal of operational and monitoring software plus server shutdown as loss of view, availability, and controlled recovery.
additional_sources.limitations: The conduct was alleged in an indictment and no facility telemetry is public.

additional_sources.title: Ongoing Cyber Threats to U.S. Water and Wastewater Systems
additional_sources.event_locator: Former employee used retained credentials to remotely access a Kansas water facility in March 2019.
additional_sources.defensive_abstraction: Stress retained-authority misuse as unapproved control access and logic-integrity risk.
additional_sources.limitations: The joint advisory provides a concise incident summary rather than raw control traces.

additional_sources.title: Conti cyber attack on the HSE: Independent Post Incident Review
additional_sources.defensive_abstraction: Represent widespread service unavailability, loss of view, manual workarounds, and phased recovery without treating clinical IT as an actuator trace.
additional_sources.limitations: Operational-service evidence is real, but it is not an OT sensor dataset or Ferrum deployment.

additional_sources.title: Cyber attack update
additional_sources.defensive_abstraction: Represent terminal and business-system disruption with vessel safety retained as a bounded availability and manual-recovery case.
additional_sources.limitations: Company update states vessels remained maneuverable and crews and cargo were safe; it is a containment case, not loss of vessel control.
